prompt: Which tropical rainforest represents a quarter of the total area of remaining tropical forests on Earth and comprises one of the largest and most biodiverse tracts of tropical rainforest in the world?
answer: The **Amazon rainforest (Amazonia)**. It is the world’s largest tropical rainforest and one of its most biodiverse ecosystems.
